_about: The map's own geometry pins (bangladesh-rivers-map): what only the map draws, apart from the diagram's 68 in tools/bangladesh-rivers-pins.json, so that file and its check stay as they are. `lines`: map-only lines, by line id, hashed as the diagram's are (tools/lib/rivers-core.mjs). `places`: map-only places, by place id, the SHA-256 (first 16 hex) of the Natural Earth feature's coordinates as the pinned file has them (tools/build-bangladesh-rivers-map.mjs). A build whose geometry moved stops and says so; it is never re-pinned to pass. kaptaiLake first pinned 2026-09-30.
